concept.description: Folds :Commit nodes that share a Git SHA into one node, so the git-clone history and the GitHub PR/Tag/Release references point at the same commit.
Links each local git clone to its GitHub repository (:Repository:Git)-[:SAME_PROJECT]->(:Repository:GitHub) via a commit they now share, after commits were folded by SHA.
concept.cypher: MATCH (h:Repository:GitHub)-[:HAS_PULL_REQUEST]->(:PullRequest)-[:HAS_HEAD|HAS_BASE]->(c:Commit) MATCH (g:Repository:Git)-[:HAS_COMMIT]->(c) WITH DISTINCT g, h MERGE (g)-[:SAME_PROJECT]->(h) RETURN count(*) AS linkedRepositories

constraint.description: No Git SHA may be represented by more than one :Commit node. Guards the merge above: a SHA that still has several nodes means the merge did not reach it.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (c:Commit) WHERE c.sha IS NOT NULL WITH c.sha AS sha, count(c) AS nodes WHERE nodes > 1 RETURN sha, nodes ORDER BY nodes DESC, sha LIMIT 50
